topic: causal inference; active learning; domain generalization; system identification; optimization
status: nine fixed-frame uniform-random full texts across three arXiv-submission periods; bounded taxonomy finding and falsifiable audit proposal, not a population estimate or novelty claim
claim: The current broad `optimization_causal_science` title/abstract screen is useful for candidate retrieval, but the nine sampled papers do not share a research estimand or outcome family. They include label-query/test-error curves, causal graph SHD/SID, attack success, sequence reward/diversity/novelty, clinical classification, uplift revenue, OOD accuracy/Dice, ODE parameter error/runtime, and an ATE-method synthesis. A pooled year trend across this tag would therefore have no common denominator and could be an artifact of changing task composition. Even causal language covers distinct objects: graph identifiability, a particular privacy attack, treatment-effect estimation, style-domain generalization, and weak-form system identification. The screen label should remain a navigation cue until full-text adjudication assigns a finer task family, estimand, evidence type, and assumptions.

counterevidence: GraN-DAG supplies a shared graph-recovery endpoint family (SHD/SID) and controlled comparisons within its own task; subtask-level comparisons are possible once the screen is narrowed.

rDRP reports four randomized online settings with equal reward budgets and a direct revenue outcome, so an operational estimate is possible within that platform/task; the authors nevertheless report one null/non-significant setting.
The style-deconfounding paper evaluates several related OOD datasets and ablations, though cell-wise effects are not uniformly positive.
falsifiable_test: On a fresh stratified sample, ask blinded reviewers to code full texts for task family, target estimand, evidence type/data provenance, metric/denominator, causal-identification assumptions, and whether a reported comparison is independently replicated. Compare those codes with groupings inferred from title/abstract tags. Measure inter-rater agreement, false cross-family pooling, and the rate at which apparent year trends vanish after task-level stratification. This finding is weakened if the broad tag reliably predicts one common estimand/metric family and pooled trends remain stable under full-text coding.

topic: active learning; generative design; clinical annotation; commercial treatment assignment
status: bounded synthesis from four sampled empirical papers; operationally falsifiable, not a pooled effect or novelty claim
claim: In this sample, reducing labels or optimizing a learned oracle does not define a single notion of success. MaxiMin reports error as a function of query count; the skin-lesion paper reaches near-full accuracy with 40–50% of its pool but has a damaging mix-up ablation; JEB-GFN produces more diverse peptide candidates while DynaPPO has a higher oracle score and GFlowNet-AL higher novelty; rDRP evaluates actual advertising revenue under matched reward budgets and reports gains in three of four online conditions. These results support a narrow evaluation hypothesis: claims of sample/budget efficiency should be judged on a predeclared vector of task quality and secondary objectives at equal budget, with an external outcome wherever feasible, rather than one selected score. They do not show that all active methods have this tradeoff or that effects can be pooled across clinical, biological, and advertising tasks.

falsifiable_test: For each task family separately, rerun candidate-selection methods at matched annotation/oracle/compute budgets, with repeated seeds and a tuned random/passive baseline. Preregister all relevant outcomes (clinical sensitivity/specificity and calibration; peptide score/diversity/novelty plus blinded wet-lab hit rate; or revenue and user/service constraints), and evaluate selected outcomes on held-out sites or future rounds. Measure Pareto-front dominance and rank stability rather than only the best single metric. The hypothesis is weakened if a scalar headline score preserves rankings and external outcomes across budget levels and contexts.
